mapper.sql: exists (select 1 from cms_topic_node n where n.id = p.node_id and n.topic_id = #{topicId} and (n.status is null or n.status = 1))
mapper.select: select id, board_key as boardKey, title, topic_id as topicId, activity_id as activityId, row_limit as rowLimit, revision from im_channel_progress_board where channel_id = #{channelId} and status = 1 order by id limit 10

select id, board_key as boardKey, title, topic_id as topicId, activity_id as activityId, row_limit as rowLimit, revision from im_channel_progress_board where channel_id = #{channelId} and board_key = #{boardKey} and status = 1
mapper.insert: insert into im_channel_progress_board(channel_id, board_key, title, topic_id, activity_id, row_limit, create_by, create_time) values (#{channelId}, #{boardKey}, #{title}, #{topicId}, #{activityId}, #{rowLimit}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp(3))
mapper.select: select count(1) from cms_topic_node where topic_id = #{topicId} and (status is null or status = 1)
select count(1) from cms_topic where id = #{topicId} and del_flag = 0

select p.member_id as memberId, count(distinct p.node_id) as done, max(p.checkin_time) as lastTime from player_node_progress p where p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.activity_id = #{activityId} and p.status = 1 and coalesce(p.del_flag, 0) = 0 and and p.member_id in #{m} group by p.member_id

select distinct p.node_id from player_node_progress p where p.topic_id = #{topicId} and p.activity_id = #{activityId} and p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.status = 1 and coalesce(p.del_flag, 0) = 0 and order by p.node_id
select max(id) from player_node_progress where topic_id = #{topicId} and activity_id = #{activityId}
